Storage Breakdown
What Smart Cleaner AI Finds on Your Mac
All scans run 100% on-device. We clearly categorize which items are generally safe to remove and which need closer review.
Item Category
Risk Profile
How Smart Cleaner AI Handles It
App & User Caches
Generally Recreated as Needed
Outdated web caches, media thumbnails, and temporary application files. Apps automatically regenerate these caches as needed.
System & Diagnostic Logs
Usually Safe to Clear
Historical crash logs, install records, and diagnostic reports that can be safely cleared to reclaim disk space.
Orphaned App Leftovers
Safe After Review
Detects hidden Application Support folders, preference plists, and crash helpers left behind by previously deleted apps.
Duplicate Files & Archives
Review Recommended
Identical files and installers saved in different folders. Shows byte-level matches side-by-side so you choose which version to keep.
Large & Forgotten Files (>100MB)
Review Recommended
Old .dmg installers, heavy zip archives, and forgotten exports sorted by last-opened date to help you declutter manually.
Developer Caches (Xcode DerivedData)
Regenerates on Next Build
Removing Xcode DerivedData and build artifacts safely frees up substantial space, though projects will take longer to index and compile on their next build.

FAQ
Common questions
Is Smart Cleaner AI a free Mac cleaner?
Yes. Smart Cleaner AI: Disk Clean is free to download on the Mac App Store. Features like Smart Scan, Disk Analyzer, cloud storage overview, app leftover scan, startup item manager, and AI recommendations are free to use. Removing apps with the uninstaller requires Pro.
How to clear space on Mac safely?
Start in System Settings > General > Storage to review storage breakdown. Then use Smart Cleaner AI to inspect large files, Downloads, unused app leftovers, and duplicate files. It brings all checks into one review-first workspace and moves items to Trash safely.
How do I clear System Data on Mac?
System Data is a macOS storage category for caches, logs, temporary files, and app support data. Never delete random system folders manually. Smart Cleaner AI safely surfaces clearable app caches and leftover files so you can reduce System Data without risking system stability.
How does this compare to other Mac cleaning utilities?
Smart Cleaner AI: Disk Clean offers a modern, privacy-first Mac cleaning experience. It runs 100% on-device with Apple's native frameworks, contains no analytics or tracking SDKs, and provides clear explanations before moving any file to Trash.
Can it find duplicate files and duplicate photos on Mac?
Yes. The built-in duplicate file finder for Mac matches files by content rather than filename across internal storage, external drives, and iCloud folders.
Does it work as an AppCleaner alternative for Mac?
Yes. The app uninstaller detects the main application bundle along with hidden preference files, caches, background helpers, and login items to ensure complete removal.
Does Smart Cleaner AI work on Apple Silicon?
Yes. Smart Cleaner AI: Disk Clean is natively built for Apple silicon Macs and also runs on Intel Macs running macOS 14.6 or later.
Do you upload my files to external servers?
No. All scanning, disk analysis, and duplicate matching run locally on your Mac using native Apple frameworks. DijitalWorlds does not operate remote scanning servers, and your personal files are never uploaded to us.
